name: MiniMax M2.7
description:
Here is how to read the MiniMax M2.7 config.json. The architecture class is MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 3,072: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 200,064 × 3,072: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 48, so each head sees 128 dimensions (3,072 / 48). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 3072 / 48 = 128. 128 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_key_value_heads is 8, so this is grouped-query attention (GQA): 48 query heads share 8 key/value groups, so the KV cache is about 6× smaller than full MHA.

num_hidden_layers is 62: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

intermediate_size is 1,536. In a SwiGLU MLP this is the high-dimensional workspace: the 3,072-wide stream is projected up, activated with silu, then projected back. Labs usually round this width to a multiple of 128 or 256 so it tiles on the chip.

max_position_embeddings is 204,800 tokens — the context window in the config. There is no rope_scaling entry, so the rotary positions are used as-is. rope_theta is 5000000: that is the wavelength of the rotary embedding. A larger theta keeps distant tokens from aliasing after a full rotation.

vocab_size is 200,064. 200,064 is divisible by 128. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

tie_word_embeddings is false, so the input embedding matrix and the output LM head are separate learned matrices rather than a shared transpose.

torch_dtype is bfloat16. Brain floating point keeps FP32’s exponent range with less mantissa, which avoids the overflow/underflow of a tiny exponent at the cost of noisier decimals — and it halves the on-chip footprint versus FP32. NVIDIA A100s were the first NVIDIA chips with native BF16; Huawei Ascend 910-class parts also prefer BF16/FP16 on the cube.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.7/blob/main/config.json.
